author: Deuglán

title: My go to productivity app
body: I have been using brain.fm for four years and it has made a huge difference to my productivity. From helping me concentrate in a busy noisy office to seeing me successfully through a new college degree over the last three years. Brain.fm is the first thing I activate when I have any reading or writing to do. It’s a great product and I would recommend it to anyone who is facing a deadline.
author: Rob Coyle

title: Good content, disastrous implementation
body:
The app and the website as a whole are a disaster. So many inconsistencies, bugs and just outright annoyances keep this from being a straight up recommendation.

I signed up with my Apple ID on the phone but then there is no way to sign in on the website!A lot of the times sign in doesn’t work, getting stuck in a perpetual losing state. The web player is very different from the app, and I am mainly interested in that one for listening to music while working. 

It’s a shame because I like the content and I’d subscribe if the platform was usable.
author: adriang133

title: Best app if you want to get the most out of your working day🧠
body:
Been using Brain.fm for a good few weeks & the simplicity of the app is golden & the science behind the app is amazing. 

If you’re working at home, I’d fully recommend this app to stay focused & get work done!
author: Cillin Hughes

title: Has really helped me focus when working from home
body: Helps me to get into zone quickly, and is also great for helping to relax in evening. Has been much more effective for me than any other app or playlist that I have tried.

title: Fantastic app for when you absolutely need to focus
body: I’ve been using this app for a long while now and it’s my go to trick when I absolutely need to focus. I find it particularly helpful when I’m tired and need to get work done, if I put on a long focus session I often find that an hour or two has passed without me looking up from my work.
